return.summary:
This group's Lean has several things standing for "what can go on after", and they differ. (a) What a level path admits at each step, compared with and without a part. This is counterfactual over the same steps, not "after". (b) Keeping widening along a continuation R that is handed in, of one course. (c) Branching.Reachable P n, of a process. (d) The map's lines (不穷, 生成, 全生成). (e) A chain Q on a course's moments. (f) Items on a finite listing.

Exact two-sided laws of widening against margin exist for the comparison: Flow.widens_iff_within_margin_at (Retaining 273), Balances.widens_iff_others_within with mixed_iff_other_beyond (OwnWidening 146/160), and Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive (1129). Their right sides do not contain widening. For opening in time (keeping widening), every concluding law read takes a going-on as a premise: an endless line, nothing lost, own widening, keeping widening or generation (generation_of_brief 707, endless_of_successor 806, eventually_widens_of_within 372, generation_iff_keepsWidening 220).

Closing is general. Branching: the future narrows under every process with no premise (reachable_invariant 448, lost_stays, necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns 432), and nothing there widens. Keeping widening is excluded along lineage under balance, Acting, Dependent and Unloosened (1125). It is also excluded under dissipation of everything required (1170), and for a finite balanced gainless whole with fixed requirements by name (339). The gain bridge (from_rest_or_open 310, open_late 320) needs by-name reading, fixed requirements (RequiresWithin), Gainless and Distinct. The built example KindRelay keeps widening within kinds while balanced, conserving and listing its conditions.

On forms changing: BeginsAlong.carries_kind_iff (921) says the lineage goes on while a line of a kind begins. begins_late_of_keepsOpening (1015) says keeping opening needs beginnings. keepsWidening_iff_generation_losing_nothing (WideningOnTheMap 228) says generation is keeping widening exactly where nothing is lost, under premises of deciding. Regions.Widens's docstring says new kinds "widen nothing".

Ways of going on tied to what can form: renewing parts do not narrow (includes_of_renewingIn 357), and a consuming part narrows under extra premises (narrows_of_consumed 368). No statement relating a way of selecting to what can go on after was found in what was read.

return.guesses:
F1: For: every widening notion read is of a web, flow, listing or chain handed in. KeepsWidening is along a continuation that is handed in. Chapter 07's widening compares with and without a part. No statement read is of a way of selecting. Qualifying: Retaining 357 ties renewing parts to not narrowing, OwnWidening 146 ties own widening to the whole's, and Weightings 1129 ties rankings to widening. The last is about rankings, not a selection's dynamics.

F2: For: from_rest_or_open 310, open_late 320 and whole_not_keepsWidening 339 conclude fed from the rest or across the boundary, or impossible for a whole. Dissipation on everything required excludes keeping widening (1170), and so does lineage under the World premises (1125). Against: these laws need by-name reading, fixed requirements (RequiresWithin), Gainless and Distinct, and the docstring names witnesses that these premises are needed (Loosening for fixed needs, not opened). The built example KindRelay balances, conserves, lists its conditions and keeps widening within kinds. So "never within a closed finite family" holds only by name with fixed requirements.

F3: For: BeginsAlong.carries_kind_iff 921 (the lineage goes on while a line of a kind begins) and begins_late_of_keepsOpening 1015 (keeping opening needs beginnings) are general, and GrammarMap defines 传 and 阶生成. Against the second half: keepsWidening_iff_generation_losing_nothing 228 says exactly when going on through change (what is held changes) is keeping widening: where nothing is lost, under wdec and found. The change there is not of kinds. Regions.Widens says new kinds widen nothing. The loss law (changed needs) is not in this group's files.

F4: For: this group has at least five such things (admission compared with and without a part; keeping widening along R; Branching.Reachable; the map's lines; the chain Q; listed items). Branching.Reachable is joined to none in what was read. Against "no law joins them": includesAcrossFrom_iff_endless 585, generation_iff_keepsWidening 220 / keepsWidening_byName_iff_generation 499, eventually_widens_of_within 372 and widens_iff_every_positive 1129 are joins.

F5: For: Branching narrows under every process with no premise, and nothing widens there. The closing laws for keeping widening are general. Every law found that concludes opening in time has a going-on among its premises. Against: the comparison has exact two-sided laws (Retaining 273, OwnWidening 146, Weightings 1129) whose right sides do not contain widening. These are not "after" in time.

return.summary:
In this group the Lean states closing in general and exactly. It states opening only from premises that already contain it. Nothing read states that the set of courses still open grows along a course.

The general laws of closing and no return, with few premises:
- Recoverable.earlier: recoverability is down-closed.
- NoReturnAt.recoverable_iff, readableInTime_iff, kernel_step_iff: the kernel is closed forward.
- Run.possible_of_next: nothing is added to the whole possible along any course.
- Run.not_possible_returns: a lost possibility has no way back.
- Run.coversLater_next and Run.not_widensWithLag_next.
- KeptFor.shorter.
- Under named premises: closed_stays_closed (with NotReadmitted), lock_outlives_loss, turned_by_loss, breaks_beyond and favours_breaking_beyond.

The only widening found along a course is Reaching.widens_next_iff_rising. It is exact and two-sided, but only on determined processes, and its right side is the course's own admissions rising. With it come the built examples Rise (the whole possible stays the same) and Climb (it keeps widening on an unlisted Nat). Guards and classes widen only by comparison: Kernel.mono, Keepable.mono, KeptFor.finer.

Forms changing while something continues:
- turns_in_time_iff_before and course_turned, a general law under premises: the way changes to the kept kind, and the line never ends exactly where the turn comes before the point of no return. It concludes continuation, not widening.
- GuardHorizon's route_retirement_allowed and overlapping_handoff_keeps_access, built examples: access goes on while its route is replaced.

Selections relate only to keeping or closing:
- shielded_choice and recomputed_* keep a guard.
- The ReadOffInTime too-late laws say when a selection read off continuation reads before the point of no return.
- favours_breaking_beyond: a rewarded rise breaks an unseen dependence.
- keeping_matters and KeptFor.finer: what a step registers decides how long a class can be kept.

"What can go on after" means more than four things in this group: Kernel, Keepable, Viable n, KeptFor n, Recoverable, Possible/PossibleWithin, Covers/Widens, and whether a run starts at all. They are joined only in part. Kernel is joined to Viable and to KeptFor, Covers to Possible, and Recoverable to a level and to a line never ending. No join of Recoverable to Kernel, Keepable or Possible was found. The TurningInTime docstring says one such link is a reading.

Chapter 07 at line 261 matches the Lean. Several sections were read only through their docstrings; the report lists them.

places.what_stands_for_after: Recoverable (591) is the set of feasible courses that agree with one course l up to step N and keep what is asked: ∃ l', feasible l' ∧ AgreeUpTo l' l N ∧ keeps l'. It is of one course at a step, and feasible and keeps are supplied; the docstring reads feasible as 'the courses the part can still take'. NoReturnAt (595) is the first step at which the course is not recoverable.

places.closing_laws:
General laws:
- Recoverable.earlier (601): Recoverable at N and n≤N gives Recoverable at n. No other premise.
- NoReturnAt.recoverable_iff (607), exact: given NoReturnAt at N, Recoverable at n ↔ n<N.
- NoReturnAt.unique (615) and NoReturnAt.parts (625).
- noReturnAt_of_past (632). Premises: recoverability decided at every step, and not recoverable at n. Conclusion: ∃N≤n with NoReturnAt.
- readableInTime_iff (661), exact: given FirstApart at T and NoReturnAt at N, ReadableInTime ↔ T<N.
- too_late_of_alike (678), too_late_of_unreached (699), too_late_within_margin (719), too_late_of_own (743), each with its premises listed in the report.
Built examples: FourReaders.recoverable_iff (977): recoverable ↔ N≤2. FourReaders.noReturn (1011): the point is 3.

Conclusion: never ends ↔ there is a first marked step T, the need met at and before it, and a point of no return N with T+1<N.

return.summary:
I answered the frozen note's six questions for nine places, from statements and docstrings. I opened one proof, More.replenishment_unbounded_from, to see the least take of one. Some laws I give from a module's account rather than the Lean: LineOnAStock's rise, line_ends and unending_iff_holds, and Entropy's Gathering. The report marks them.

Nearest to "forms change while the continuation continues": the grammar's generation «生成» (GrammarMap 274). It is a continuing in which, ahead of every point, the kind goes on while a new carrier begins («传»). LineageRegions concludes it only where something that already goes on is handed in: every member reproduces (generation_of_reproducing 405), or transmission is exact from t on (generation_of_positive_term 461). Its account says no witness of going on under balance and dissipation is shown.

Closing laws are general and many. Arising has depletion_not_recurring, dissipation_arising_not_recurring and substitution_defers. Roles has embodiedArising_not_recurring, Entropy never_revisits and rests_of_never_revisits, Dependence consumed_ends_when_fixed, Evolution never_supported_childless. LineageRegions has two exact laws: generation_degenerates_iff (a whole generation degenerates iff a later generation is empty, with KidsContinue and ContinuationsListed) and degenerates_iff_line_ends.

Under the first law, Gain says where every rise, novelty and new support comes from: the rest, or across the boundary (rise_from_rest_or_open, whole_rise_from_rest, newly_supported_from_rest_or_open). None of these laws concludes an opening. Change of form is stated in four places:
- Dependence's consumed_continues_transformed: after a loss, what is still active needs less, or no longer needs the condition.
- Arising's substitution_defers: changing what it rests on within an unrenewed finite family does not escape the end.
- Evolution's variation: bounded drift of a need's amount (TransmitsWithin, transmitted_along).
- LineOnAStock's ways_alike: no new kind arrives without a difference already made.

No law found says that continuing through change widens what can go on after. New kinds were not found: births are within the kind.

A way of selecting is related to going on or ending, not to widening:
- generation_of_positive_term
- Courses.same_terms_two_fates: the same selection terms, two fates
- ways_alike

On the note's test: "already there" is not met in this group, and F5 is supported.

places.what_stands_for_after: Arising itself: Web.Arises (93), not active then active; Web.Unceasing (97), some formation arises at arbitrarily late steps. Stated of one web. The account (17-18) says: 'what does not cease is arising, not any particular form'. The header (10-13) says the second 生 ranges over what can form, which this module does not state. On the grammar, arising is 生 (arises_iff_sheng 725) and renewal is 复生 (renews_iff 748).
places.opening_laws: No general law concludes Unceasing. Built examples: Oscillation.unceasing 565, Recycle.closed_unceasing 484, Tide.unrelated_depletion 261. Two exact restatements, each with no premise: unceasing_iff_late_beginnings (734), W.Unceasing ↔ ∀ N, ∃ y, N < y.1 ∧ W.active y.1 y.2 ∧ «生» Steps.along W.activityClass y; and renews_iff (748), «复生» … (t,f) ∧ W.active (t+1) f ↔ W.Arises t f ∧ W.active (t+2) f.
places.closing_laws: depletion_not_recurring (170): from still (∀ t ≥ T, Still cs t) and Depletes cs event, ¬∀N ∃t≥N, event t. Unceasing.rises (182): Depletes cs arising and Unceasing give ¬∀ t ≥ T, Still. activeRenewer_recurs (190) adds RenewedBy renews. substitution_defers (201): still from T and Depletes cs (active f) give ¬∀N ∃t≥N, active t f. dissipation_arising_not_recurring (208): q never rises (q(t+1) ≤ q t) and every arising lowers it give ¬Unceasing. Built example: Growth.ceases 323. Each is of one course: it stops from some step on.
places.forms_change: Relay.defers (387), a built example: the dependence dissolves on the first source, forms on the second, and the formation ends. The general law substitution_defers says 'Substitution defers the end and does not escape it'. So change of form is stated here and concludes a narrowing.
places.from_where: Unceasing arising needs a member of the depleted family to rise at arbitrarily late steps, and with RenewedBy, renewing activity recurs. Recycle.closed_unceasing is a built example: a closed two-pool family, total held at one, sustains unceasing arising without dissipation. That is return, not novelty.
places.way_related_to_widening: Not found. The account (77-78) says more takers, diversity and complexity are not stated here.

places.what_stands_for_after: Novelty of a family's configuration: new at every step, or first visits NewAt (133). What can newly form: FirstSupported T t f (192), supported at t and at no step from T before ('it can first form there'). Both of one course.
places.opening_laws: None concludes that more can form; each law takes newness as a premise. supported_of_config (185): RequiresWithin cs f and the same config at s and t; Supported t f → Supported s f ('What can form depends on the configuration'). newAt_of_first (198). rises_late_of_newly_supported (205), premises: increasing at_; ∀n, T ≤ at_ n; ∀n, RequiresWithin cs (f n) (what f requires, and how much, is fixed and within cs); ∀n, FirstSupported T (at_ n) (f n); any M. Conclusion: ∃t≥M, stock cs t < stock cs (t+1).
places.closing_laws: With every (∀c, c ∈ all), Distinct all, Gainless and the rest idle from T: whole_bounded_of_rest_idle (299) gives stock within its value at T; whole_recurs_of_rest_idle (312) gives a configuration taken twice from every step on and, with exchange recurring, ¬CarriesHistory; whole_not_new_of_rest_idle (322) gives not new at every step ('return, not novelty without end'). That newly supported formations without end are impossible there is my join of two laws, not a theorem.
places.forms_change: Not found: newAt_of_first ties new support to a new configuration only.
places.from_where: rise_netGiver (229), no premise: some relatum with the rest counted gives net. rise_given (262): the rest or a formation. rise_from_rest_or_open (279): Gainless, Distinct cs and a rise give the rest giving net ∨ ¬ClosedAt cs t. whole_rise_from_rest (290): every, distinct, gainless and a rise give the rest giving net. newly_supported_from_rest_or_open (351). new_beyond_every (341). These need the first law, not dissipation. No cost is stated. The account says it does not derive whether a part is open or what the rest is.

places.from_where: More.replenishment_unbounded (748), premises Balances W (∀ t c, level(t+1)+taken = level t+given), More cs, R, T₀; conclusion ¬∀t≥T₀, replenishment cs t ≤ R. The proof uses a least take of one. renewers_unbounded (763) adds Capacity cs g. uptake_needs_replenishment (589). Steady (912), a built example: uptake with nothing arising. The account: carrying taking beyond every finite part needs dissipation.

places.what_stands_for_after: Arising of embodied relata: Embodied x (414), ∀t, active t x ↔ 0 < level t x. Here 'opens' means the boundary is not closed.
places.opening_laws: embodiedArising_opens (695): Balances, Dissipative (every closed family without repetition is dissipated on), Distinct ds, embodied members of ds arising at arbitrarily late steps, T; conclusion ¬∀t≥T, ClosedAt ds t. embodiedArising_draws_in (717) adds Around from T₀ and concludes ¬∀t≥N, Inward ds t. The opening is of the boundary, from arising handed in.
places.closing_laws: Embodied.arising_lowers (657): Balances, Dissipative, Distinct ds, ClosedAt ds t, Embodied x, x ∈ ds, Arises t x; conclusion stock ds (t+1) < stock ds t. embodiedArising_not_recurring_on: Balances and DissipatesOn ds from T. embodiedArising_not_recurring (725): Balances, Dissipative, Distinct all, every; no embodied arising at arbitrarily late steps.
places.forms_change: Embodied.arises_given (505): Balances, Acting (only active formations give), Embodied x and Arises t x give ∃f, active t f ∧ f ∈ present t ∧ 0 < give t f x ∧ f ≠ x. A new carrier is given by another. Brood (account only) is a built example of generations. Nothing says the kinds differ or that this widens.
places.from_where: Under balance and dissipation each embodied arising in a closed family lowers its stock, with another member falling (arising_with_fall). Without dissipation, Shuttle bears unceasing arising (account only).
places.way_related_to_widening: Not found.

places.what_stands_for_after: Descent: DescendsAt (154), g present, g gives to x, x comes to stand. A lineage is a sequence of descents (315). One flow.
places.opening_laws: none found in what was read
places.closing_laws: unsupported_childless (195): Acting, Dependent and ¬Supported t g give no descendant across t. never_supported_childless (200). Drawdown (546), a built example: the descendant with the inherited need is unsupported from step 1 on.
places.forms_change: TransmitsWithin c δ (256), a premise: a descendant's need is at most the parent's plus δ. transmitted_along (315), a general law: need after i+1 descents ≤ the founder's need + (i+1)δ, given descents, depends and steady. In Drawdown (built example) the varied descendant that needs less is supported and active. Variation is of a need's amount only; no law says it widens.
places.from_where: transmitted_within (301): Balances, Acting, Dependent, TransmitsWithin, DescendsAt (S+n) x g and requires; conclusion need + uptake since S ≤ level S + replenishment since S + δ ('Activity sets later selection').
places.way_related_to_widening: Selection through support (selected_le, selection_within) bounds descendants' needs. transmitted_within relates what is taken to what can later be transmitted, as a bound and not a widening. Fitness is not defined.

places.what_stands_for_after: Grammar regions at an occurrence on the lineage continuation, over a census G handed in: «延» going on, «尽»/«退化» ending on every branch. «生成» (GrammarMap 274): along some branch the pattern goes on, with a carrying renewal «传» (kind continues while a carrier begins) ahead of every point. 'Regions are properties of points.'
places.opening_laws: generation_of_reproducing (405), premises: Acting; Descended L W G; WithinKind G Q; EmbodiedOffspring; ∀s q, t ≤ s → q ∈ family s → ∃k ∈ kids s q; p ∈ family t. Conclusion «生成» (lineStep L W Q) (kindClass Q) carrierClass (t,p). generation_of_positive_term (461): the same, plus ByNumber, Exact transmission from t on and 0 < concordAt t; some member of generation t generates. not_all_degenerate_of_nonempty (709): KidsContinue and every generation from t nonempty give ¬∀ p ∈ family t, «退化».
places.closing_laws: generation_degenerates_iff (673), exact: KidsContinue (continuationStep R) Lc G and ContinuationsListed give (∀p ∈ family t, «退化» (t,p)) ↔ ∃N ≥ t, size N = 0. degenerates_iff_line_ends (691), exact: KidsContinue and ContinuationsAreKids give «退化» (t,p) ↔ ∃D ∀j, ¬ListedDescendant G t p D j. degeneration_of_dissipation (557): Descended; offspring within ds; BalancesOn and DissipatesOn ds for t < stock ds 0 + 1; ContinuationsListed; t ≤ stock + 1; conclusion «退化». No exact law of generation against degeneration: the König-type choice is not shown.
places.forms_change: Generation is, by definition, carriers beginning while the kind continues. It is concluded where reproduction or exact transmission is handed in. New kinds are not stated (WithinKind). At the own-kind grain the impossibility law fails (Chain.kinds_apart). «新而尽» is met by OneBirth: renewing and still ending. No law says the change widens.
places.from_where: Under balance and dissipation, with the census, the lineage degenerates (degeneration_of_dissipation). A witness of going on under balance and dissipation is 'Not shown'.
places.way_related_to_widening: A selection term proper positive at t, with exact transmission, gives generation (generation_of_positive_term). In Courses.same_terms_two_fates (built examples), the same terms through a horizon have two fates: 'terms through a horizon need not decide the region'. Courses.positive_but_last is evolutionary suicide. These relate selecting to going on or ending, not to widening.

places.what_stands_for_after: A formation still active after a loss. Single-step classes: Kept (139), Broken (143), with kept_or_broken (231) and kept_not_broken; RenewingAt (294), BreakingOn (300), UnderminingOn (318), with BreakingOn.undermining, RenewingAt.not_undermining and not_breaking. Whole-run: Consumed (152), Lost (157), a met dependence broken and never met again.
places.opening_laws: none found in what was read
places.closing_laws: consumed_ends_when_fixed (284): Dependent, the dependence fixed for t > T (requires, need T ≤ need t) and level below need T for t > T give ∀t > T, ¬active t g. Also renewed_not_consumed and renewing_not_consuming.
places.forms_change: consumed_continues_transformed (269): Dependent; below: ∀t > T, level t c < need T g c; T < t; active t g. Conclusion ¬(requires t g c ∧ need T g c ≤ need t g c): 'a formation that is still active has weakened or dissolved its dependence'. The _at form (261) needs only Supported t g. The account: whether one formation transforms or one ends as another forms depends on the identity stipulated by F (Crossing witness, body not read). No widening is stated.
places.from_where: none found in what was read

places.what_stands_for_after: The course of ways (lists of units, each with need, use and kids) and a level; the net has a next while some need is met.
places.opening_laws: Not read in the Lean. The account names rise and the exact middle case unending_iff_holds: under even, some, down, needs, nothing, high and Regime, the net never ends exactly where the course reaches a configuration that holds. From the account only.
places.closing_laws: From the account only: never_in and gone_from ('What is lost of a line does not come back'), line_ends, way_ends, fall, need_unmet.
places.forms_change: ways_alike (547), a general law: two givings, two uses, two start levels, one way, need and kids. If ∀j < n the levels meet the same needs of the first course's way, then ∀j ≤ n the ways are equal: 'a difference in the ways, new kinds included, arrives only after a step at which the levels met different needs'. born_alike (587): numbers born are equal for j < n. The account (102): 'nothing here makes a new kind or changes kids'.
places.from_where: The giving's bounds are premises (account).
places.way_related_to_widening: ways_alike relates a selection (needs met) to what follows: courses alike in it are the same way. It says what cannot differ, not what widens.

places.what_stands_for_after: The family's configuration: whether it Changes or Revisits. One course.
places.opening_laws: changes_persist (1334): Determined cs T next; ¬Merges cs T next; T ≤ v; Changes cs v. Conclusion ∀n, Changes cs (v+n) ('Merging nothing, change goes on'). The going on is handed in as a change made and a law that merges nothing. Gathering is a built example of an arrow drawn from beyond, world not finite (account only).
places.closing_laws: Balances.never_revisits (1181): Balances and DissipatesOn cs from T give ¬Revisits cs T. Balances.rests_of_never_revisits (1225): Balances, GainlessOn from T and ¬Revisits give ¬∀N ∃t≥N, Changes. Balances.unending_change_revisits (1235): Balances, Gainless from T and change at arbitrarily late steps give ¬¬Revisits. World.never_revisits (1681): distinct, every, balanced, dissipative. World.rests_of_never_revisits (1659): distinct, every, Embodied, balanced, Gainless and never revisiting give ¬ArisingRecurs ∧ ¬CeasingRecurs. That dissipation brings rest is my join.
places.forms_change: Not found: the configuration changes and returns; nothing here is of other kinds.
places.from_where: Under the first law, change without end is return; 'what rises with no premise is the history'. An arrow without end under exact conservation 'draws on what lies beyond the family'.
places.way_related_to_widening: Not found.

return.guesses:
F1. For: Arising, Gain, Flow, Roles, Dependence and Entropy say nothing of a way of selecting. «生成» is stated of a census handed in. Gain's FirstSupported is near widening, of one web. Against: generation_of_positive_term and Courses.same_terms_two_fates relate a selection term to generation, and ways_alike relates selection to what follows. So the guess fails for going on and ending, and holds for widening.

F2. For: rise_from_rest_or_open, whole_rise_from_rest, newly_supported_from_rest_or_open, new_beyond_every, embodiedArising_opens and _not_recurring, More.replenishment_unbounded, degeneration_of_dissipation and never_revisits each conclude a source from the rest or across the boundary, an open boundary, or an end. Qualify: Gain needs only the first law, not dissipation. Without dissipation, Recycle.closed_unceasing and Cycle.closed_more (built examples) bear unceasing arising and more takers within a closed finite family of conditions. These are return under the first law (whole_not_new_of_rest_idle, unending_change_revisits). So F2 holds for novelty or new formation. It fails for more takers if dissipation is dropped.

F3. For: consumed_continues_transformed is a general law. substitution_defers is a general law that changing dependence within an unrenewed finite family still ends. «生成»/«传» is a continuing with carriers beginning. TransmitsWithin and transmitted_along give variation of need. No law says continuing through change widens. Against: new kinds were not found.
